name: The Patents Act, 1970
description: Principal Indian patent statute governing patentability of inventions.

name: Section 3(p) Patents Act
description: Statutory exclusion of traditional knowledge and non-synergistic admixtures.

name: Section 3(d) Patents Act
description: Requirement of enhanced therapeutic efficacy for new forms of known substances.

name: Section 3(e) Patents Act
description: Exclusion of mere admixtures lacking synergistic technical interactions.

name: Section 10(4)(d)(ii) Patents Act
description: Mandatory disclosure of biological material source and geographical origin.

name: Section 25(1)(k) Opposition
description: Pre-grant patent opposition grounds based on traditional knowledge anticipation.

name: Biological Diversity Act, 2002
description: National legislation implementing access and benefit sharing (ABS) for Indian bio-resources.

name: Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
description: Decriminalized framework and codification of AYUSH practitioner exemptions.

name: Section 3 BDA Approvals
description: Mandatory prior approval for foreign entities accessing Indian biological resources.

name: Section 6 BDA IPR Approval
description: Mandatory NBA approval before applying for or commercializing patent rights based on Indian bio-resources.

name: Section 40 BDA NTC Exemptions
description: Exemption from ABS provisions for Normally Traded Commodities listed in official gazette notifications.

name: National Biodiversity Authority
description: Statutory body governing access, approvals, and benefit sharing under the BD Act.

name: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks
description: National IP office administering patent, design, and trademark registrations.

name: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940
description: Statute regulating manufacture, licensing, and standards of ASU drugs.

name: Rule 158B D&C Rules
description: Proof of safety and effectiveness requirements for Patent/Proprietary Ayurvedic medicines.

name: Schedule T GMP Standards
description: Good Manufacturing Practices mandatory for Ayurvedic medicine manufacturing facilities.

name: FSSAI Ayurveda Aahar Regulations, 2022
description: Regulatory framework for dietary and nutritional food supplements under Ayurvedic principles.

name: WIPO GRATK Treaty, 2024
description: International mandatory disclosure requirements for genetic resources and traditional knowledge in patent applications.

name: Withania somnifera (Ashwagandha)
description: Standardized Rasayana herb widely documented in Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India.

name: Curcuma longa (Haridra / Turmeric)
description: Traditional anti-inflammatory and antiseptic botanical rhizome.

name: Ocimum sanctum (Tulsi / Holy Basil)
description: Adaptogenic aromatic herb utilized in classical Rasayana formulations.
